test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A car travels from A to B at 80 km/h and returns at 60 km/h. Find the approx. average speed of the car.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance covered is the same for both speeds, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) / (x + y)

Here, x = 80 km/h and y = 60 km/h.

Average Speed = (2 × 80 × 60) / (80 + 60) = 9600 / 140 = 960 / 14

Average Speed = 480 / 7 ≈ 68.57 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 68.57 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed from A to B (S₁) = 80 km/h

Speed from B to A (S₂) = 60 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95f28bbda53e3fd5fcf1ef79db8e1c6b496d1a9ef6c286d9b1f93f487acf2ac3.png] 

Let the distance between A and B be the LCM of 80 and 60 = 240 km.

⇒ Time taken from A to B (t₁) = 240 ÷ 80 = 3 hours

⇒ Time taken from B to A (t₂) = 240 ÷ 60 = 4 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 240 + 240 = 480 km

⇒ Total Time = 3 + 4 = 7 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 480 ÷ 7

⇒ Average Speed ≈ 68.57 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 68.57 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Time)

If a person travels for equal time intervals at speeds v₁ and v₂, then Average Speed = (v₁ + v₂) ÷ 2.

Harmonic Mean Property

The average speed for equal distances is the Harmonic Mean of the individual speeds: 2 ÷ [(1/v₁) + (1/v₂)].

Conversion of Units

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.
